description: Source code for AES (Rijndael) cipher implementation supporting only 128-bit keys, including key setup, encryption, and decryption functions with options for size optimization (AES_SMALL_TABLES).

methods.name: rijndaelKeySetupEnc
methods.description: Expands cipher key into the encryption key schedule for AES.

methods.name: rijndaelKeySetupDec
methods.description: Expands cipher key into the decryption key schedule for AES.

methods.name: rijndaelEncrypt
methods.description: Performs AES encryption on a 16-byte plaintext block using the expanded key schedule.

methods.name: rijndaelDecrypt
methods.description: Performs AES decryption on a 16-byte ciphertext block using the expanded key schedule.
